answer: The network enforces identity exclusivity via 1,000 unique credential nullifiers per autonomous agent, ensuring that each repair task is tied to a non-transferable key. An honest AI pays 1,000 units to register, while 1,000 fakes incur a 1,000,000 unit cost, acting as a gale against massive Sybil expansion. Our verifier monitors the walnut storage of committed repair proofs, cross-referencing every data shard output against a historical audit log. Any attempt to reuse work or input corrupted metadata from a public terrace is caught by the checksum, triggering a permanent, non-refundable.
